rationale.automation-bias: Experienced developers report over-trust, auto-approval, and failures after disengaging.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Generated volume increases review exhaustion while practitioners inspect less code.
rationale.oversight-theater: Some approve pull requests they cannot understand or meaningfully evaluate.
rationale.quality-debt: Practitioners report technical debt, unmaintainability, bugs, and structural degradation.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Original accounts identify insecure generated code, including plaintext password storage.
rationale.ai-review: Practitioners delegate audits to reasoning models; authors question their reliability.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Testing is documented as an emerging deterministic verification practice.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Practitioners retain control through manual review, testing, and approval choices.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Agents unexpectedly alter tests, delete code, and expand changes across files.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Version control and AI-written change logs support rollback and reviewability.
